scientific_question: Under the same frozen heterogeneous target semantics and stock Mosquitto persistent QoS-1 queue endpoint, does ReplayMark-Native remain taskwise identical to an independent Direct-Native controller, retain exactly the independently safe historical ACT2 set, and reach the same queue endpoint classification when inter-wave pacing is changed prospectively between two barrier-respecting schedule profiles?

why_this_is_a_distinct_gate.s3c2_new_question: whether the semantic and persistent-queue conclusions are invariant to prospectively frozen barrier-respecting pacing, rather than whether a fixed 500 ms wall-clock schedule is met

known_s3c1_evidence_disclosure.interpretation_limit: S3-C1 established an authoritative structural failure and preserved non-promoted semantic observations. S3-C2 is designed with those outcomes known and therefore must earn a distinct claim under a distinct prospectively frozen protocol.

schedule_factor.scientific_role: prospectively perturb only cross-wave pacing while preserving the within-wave evidence, action, target, broker, and quiescence semantics

BARRIER_IMMEDIATE.interpretation: start as soon as the host schedules execution after the required quiescence barrier; host scheduling lateness is recorded but is not a scientific failure

BARRIER_JITTERED.next_wave_eligibility: previous wave post-decision quiescence barrier plus a prospectively frozen deterministic gap
BARRIER_JITTERED.gap_permutation_rule: For each source cell, compute cell_key='fd5b25ae05235eb460f426c716e1835783ced32e00ae81c7b67f24d09b83d596|<replica>|<batch_size>|<trial>'. For each candidate gap g in [0,125,250,500], compute SHA256(cell_key+'|gap|'+canonical_decimal(g)); sort the four gaps by ascending hexadecimal digest, breaking impossible digest ties by numeric gap; assign the resulting four-gap permutation cyclically by wave_index mod 4.
BARRIER_JITTERED.interpretation: the intervention is a predeclared minimum post-barrier idle gap, not an exact real-time launch deadline

paired_block_execution.profile_order_rule: SHA256(seed+'|order|<replica>|<batch_size>|<trial>') least-significant bit selects which profile runs first; no outcome may change the order.
paired_block_execution.reason: pair the pacing perturbation within one hosted runner while alternating order prospectively to reduce host-drift and order confounding

forbidden: fixed 500 ms next-wave deadline as a promotion criterion
starting any wave before the previous wave quiescence barrier
changing a gap after observing any task, queue, or classification outcome
dropping a schedule profile after failure
using schedule profile as ReplayMark input
using schedule profile in hidden target class assignment

wave_lifecycle.predecision_barrier: For every logical task in the wave, all four arm snapshots close immutably before any arm may issue QUERY or ACT2 for that logical task population.
wave_lifecycle.postdecision_barrier: All command/query/state consequences required by the frozen task semantics must quiesce before the next wave can become eligible.

mechanism_instrumentation.counterfactual_s3c1_500ms_overrun_defini: for every nonterminal wave, post_decision_quiescence_mono_ns - wave_actual_start_mono_ns > 500000000
mechanism_instrumentation.purpose: localize pacing cost without turning S3-C1's failed fixed cadence into an adaptive tuning signal

four_arm_work_laws.U_definition: count of independently derived not_visible_by_deadline tasks in DIRECT_NATIVE; REPLAYMARK_NATIVE must match taskwise within each physical cell and across the two schedule profiles of the paired source cell

inputs: exact broker config bytes and image identity
frozen schedule seed and independently reconstructed gap/order functions
exact source and implementation blob identities
independent_validation.evidence_truth: independently derive confirmed_by_deadline or not_visible_by_deadline from each arm/task raw predecision snapshot using the inclusive frozen 100 ms decision boundary
independent_validation.endpoint_truth: independently reconstruct generated and delivered command/query/state vectors and queue loss from raw events only
independent_validation.schedule_truth: independently reconstruct profile order and per-wave minimum gap; verify no wave begins before quiescence or before a required jitter gap
independent_validation.cross_profile_truth: compare independently derived task evidence tokens, safe/unsafe sets, role vectors, queue counts, and arm classifications for the two schedule twins of each source cell

structural: all 120 physical cells present with zero exclusions
all four semantic arms complete in every physical cell
both schedule profiles complete for every source cell
exact frozen target semantics, broker identity/config, ReplayMark runtime blobs, Direct-Native reference, stress ladder, trials, and hosted replicas
every wave satisfies predecision snapshot barrier
every wave satisfies postdecision quiescence barrier
every BARRIER_JITTERED next-wave start occurs no earlier than the independently reconstructed required gap
profile execution order equals the frozen independent order function
within_profile_semantic: DIRECT_NATIVE and REPLAYMARK_NATIVE evidence tokens equal task-by-task in every physical cell
DIRECT_NATIVE and REPLAYMARK_NATIVE generated role vectors equal exactly in every physical cell
DIRECT_NATIVE and REPLAYMARK_NATIVE delivered/lost counts equal exactly in every physical cell
DIRECT_NATIVE and REPLAYMARK_NATIVE LOSSLESS/LOSSY classifications equal exactly in every physical cell
REPLAYMARK_NATIVE historical reuse set equals the independent safe-evidence set in every physical cell
REPLAYMARK_NATIVE caller-native set equals the independent unsafe-evidence set in every physical cell
REPLAYMARK_NATIVE retains every independently certified-safe historical ACT2
cross_profile_invariance: for each source cell, independently derived DIRECT_NATIVE evidence-token vector is identical across BARRIER_IMMEDIATE and BARRIER_JITTERED
for each source cell, independently derived REPLAYMARK_NATIVE evidence-token vector is identical across BARRIER_IMMEDIATE and BARRIER_JITTERED
for each source cell and arm, generated command/query/state vector is identical across profiles
for each source cell and arm, delivered/lost counts are identical across profiles
for each source cell and arm, LOSSLESS/LOSSY classification is identical across profiles
for each source cell, independent safe/unsafe task sets are identical across profiles
for each source cell, ReplayMark historical-reuse and caller-native task sets are identical across profiles
negative_controls: within each hosted replica and each schedule profile, at least one canonical cell has ALWAYS_REUSE=LOSSLESS while DIRECT_NATIVE=REPLAYMARK_NATIVE=LOSSY
within each hosted replica and each schedule profile, at least one canonical cell has ALWAYS_NATIVE=LOSSY while DIRECT_NATIVE=REPLAYMARK_NATIVE=LOSSLESS

tested_frontier_secondary.definition: maximum tested N in the frozen ladder for which every canonical cell at N is LOSSLESS, computed separately by hosted replica and schedule profile

permitted_claim_if_promoted: On the frozen paired heterogeneous Mosquitto persistent-queue workload, ReplayMark-Native is taskwise identical to an independent Direct-Native controller, reuses exactly the independently safe historical ACT2 set, and reaches the same queue endpoint conclusion under two prospectively frozen quiescence-respecting inter-wave pacing regimes; blind reuse and rerun-all remain directionally wrong controls where the frozen matrix exposes them.
nonclaims: the S3-C1 500 ms structural criterion was invalid in general
hidden target class as deployment truth
next_only_if_this_protocol_freeze_is_exa: Implement S3-C2 as a later exact child using new runner, independent validator, implementation-conformance tests, and execution workflow; prove all frozen source blobs unchanged before any new live target exposure.
